_doc: Controlled vocabulary. A tag is facet:value. Multi-valued facets may repeat. This is a STARTER: keep the structure, replace the domain facets (layer, cause, engine) and add your own (see procedures/P05-design-the-taxonomy.md).

values.regression: used to work, broke after a change
values.question: asks how something works

layer.doc: Where in the system the problem sits (REPLACE with your project's real layers, see P05)

cause.doc: Root cause (use unknown when not established; grow this list from what you actually see)

symptom.doc: What the reporter saw (often derived from the text by keyword rules, so weak labels). Separate from the mechanism (layer, cause).

values.stall-after-bytes: transfer starts, then stalls or freezes (partial page, video loads endlessly, byte-count cutoff)
values.connection-reset: connection reset or RST from the network
values.timeout-no-response: timeouts, no answer, unreachable, no route
values.slow-throughput: works but slow: speed drop, throttling, low goodput
values.no-effect: the bypass has no visible effect or the strategy does not fire
values.breaks-other-sites: collateral damage: unrelated sites, apps or games break
values.works-then-stops: worked before, stopped after time, an update or a change (decay)
values.voice-call-fails: voice or video calls fail (RTC connecting, no route, calls die)
values.wrong-probe-result: the probing tool reports a wrong availability result
values.dns-wrong-answer: hijacked, spoofed or wrong DNS answers
values.service-wont-start: the daemon or service does not start or exits at once
values.crash-or-hang: crash, segfault, deadlock, reboot or system hang
values.unsupported-platform: platform, kernel or feature not supported
values.config-ignored: a list, filter or option seems to be ignored
